source: Mixture of Experts introduces another scaling axis: conditional computation. The model can own a large bank of parameters while activating only a subset for a particular input. The central goal is not “free parameters.” It is to decouple, to some degree, the amount of parameter capacity stored in the model from the amount of expert computation applied to one token.
zh: 专家混合引入了另一个缩放轴：条件计算。该模型可以拥有大量参数，同时仅激活特定输入的子集。中心目标不是“自由参数”。它在某种程度上将模型中存储的参数容量与应用于一个令牌的专家计算量解耦。
